theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero and let B be a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme carrying a smooth proper curve family pi:C->B with geometrically connected genus-6 fibres together with a finite flat degree-four map gamma:C->P^1_B whose Casnati–Ekedahl relations bundle is fibrewise balanced, F_b ≅ O(4)⊕O(5). Use the canonical filtered quotient W_5 of ATT-0066 (dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116) and put L=W_5⊗ω_{C/B}^{-1}. Assume the weak CE relative-canonical normalization of ATT-0066/FND-0105 fibrewise, so L_b ≅ ω_{C_b}(-D_b) with D_b a fibre of gamma_b. Then on every geometric fibre: (R1) |L_b| is a base-point-free complete g^2_6 (in particular h^0(L_b)=3); (R2) writing |L_b|≅P^2 for the fibre of the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence I=Hilb^6(C/B)×_{Pic^6(C/B)}B, the reduced-support open U_b⊂|L_b| of divisors with six pairwise-distinct points is a nonempty Zariski-dense open, and its complement (the nonreduced locus) is a nonempty proper closed subset; (R3) the ordered Conf_6 incidence over b is therefore nonempty of pure dimension 2. Consequently every proposed balanced residual component decomposition that assigns an empty reduced-support (or empty ordered Conf_6) piece to some balanced geometric fibre is false. No claim is made about image dimension, purity, or codimension in M_{6,6}, about S_6 monodromy, or about RED-0001.
